_note: Dark-web RSS sources, fetched only through Tor (Tor Browser open, or the Tor service running). Add ONLY onion addresses you verified on the outlet's own official website - fake onion lookalikes are common. A v3 onion address is 56 characters (a-z, 2-7) followed by .onion; anything else is rejected. Example shape: {"name": "Outlet name", "url": "http://<56-char-address>.onion/feed.xml", "type": "rss"}
